I don't think it's workable as written, so I'm telling you plainly instead of breaking it quietly: I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you also announce take, a collision splits the cells randomly. If you'd rather settle this another way, tell me and I'll weigh it, but I won't pretend I'm operating.
